text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Urgh… It's already this late?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But I can't stop yet! No first-rate runner would quit so early!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. King's still at it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can begin cooling down after witnessing such a fiery display of passion!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's keep training! I want to explore just how far I can push my limits!
choice_data_list: We'd better call it a day. You'll end up overworking yourself otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Thank you! All right, I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You've got guts, King! But can you keep up with my brilliance?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I hope you enjoy playing catch-up, because that's all you'll be doing with me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …You're right. I can't aim for the world stage with blind determination alone. But I also can't just stand here and watch her run…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I can use my pent-up passion to cheer for her!
